description: Extension of docs/analysis/data/io-input-scripts.json for tools/observe_animation_machine_io_ext.py (same format). Entries with the same name as in the base file are verbatim copies (checked by the tool). New: the declared default settings (host write set default-settings) and the input scripts jumpshoot, grenadeturn, mixed. Every value is a declaration, not a BIOS, IRQ-timing or device claim. Design and results: docs/analysis/area-c-completion-plan.md section 10.

ports.380000: BYTE system port (active low): bit0 P1 start, bit1 P1 select, bit2 P2 start, bit3 P2 select [I: input-sampler.md]
ports.300000: BYTE P1 port (active low): bit0 up, bit1 down, bit2 left, bit3 right, bit4 A, bit5 B, bit6 C, bit7 D
ports.340000: BYTE P2 port (active low), same bit layout as 300000
ports.3c0006: WORD raster / video status read by the frame head (eaa, efc); declared 0

semantics.frame: Frame number k of the D1 frame protocol. Frame 0 is the N0 pass (no head, no external read); the values of frame k >= 1 are served to the H of that frame.
semantics.repeat: A value applies to every read of that port inside the frame (pause loops that read again see the same value).
semantics.defaults: Port values of every frame before any segment applies (all released: BYTE ff, raster 0000).
semantics.segment: {from, to (inclusive, null = open), port, optional every + phase [a, b] (absolute frame number modulo every inside [a, b], inclusive), and one or more of value (replace), clear (bits cleared, active low press), set (bits set)}. Segments apply in file order.
semantics.queue_limit: Optional per-port number of values the frame queue holds (default 32 = FH.QLEN). A read beyond it is the checked stop external-read-queue-empty.
semantics.consumption: What the C++ harness receives is the native consumption log (address, size, value in consumption order), not this table.

none.description: Nothing pressed: all ports released, raster 0.

walkfire.description: IO-1 probe walkfire: from frame 20 P1 right held, A toggling every 4 frames, B pulsed 6 frames out of 64. No start, select or coin bit (scope decision 3).

jumpshoot.description: From frame 20, period 48: P1 right held; A pressed 2 of every 6 frames; B pressed phase 0..3 (jump); down held phase 14..29 (aim down in the air, then crouch); up held phase 34..43 (aim up). No start, select or coin bit.

grenadeturn.description: From frame 20, period 96: P1 right held phase 0..47, left held phase 48..95 (turn); C pressed 2 of every 24 frames (grenade); A pressed 2 of every 10 frames; down held phase 60..83 (crouch, crouch shot and grenade); B pressed phase 30..33 (jump while turning). No start, select or coin bit.

mixed.description: From frame 20, period 160 in eight 20-frame windows: (0) right + A held (no repeat), (1) right + B held 8 frames then down + A, (2) left + up + A pulses, (3) nothing, (4) down + C pulses, (5) right + D pulses + B, (6) up + B then A + C together, (7) left + down (crouch walk) with A pulses. No start, select or coin bit.

game-mode.why: D9 configuration (ii): the stage controller LONG 1008e4 := c7fc (game-mode controller)
D9 configuration (ii): BYTE 10fdaf := 2 (BIOS game mode); b68 copies it to 100012 in the H of frame 1

player-start-p1.why: declared effect of the BIOS PLAYER_START call for P1: BYTE 10f006 |= 1 (OR.B D0,10f006 at ae4); b68 turns the bit into BYTE 10fdb6 := 1 in the H of frame 1
player-start-p1.evidence: a74 -> abc -> OR.B D0,10f006 (ae4); b68 BCLR/MOVE.B #1,(A0,D0.W); scope decision 2

default-settings.why: declared effect of the game default-settings path bbfa -> bc1e for P1: the four BYTEs of ROM 49ab0 (10 20 40 80) copied to 10f01c..10f01f. In game mode (BYTE 100012 = 2) the input helper 49b3a uses 10f01c as the A / B / C / D button masks; with the zero seed RAM every button reads as held and never as newly pressed
default-settings.evidence: bc1e LEA 49ab0,A0; LEA 10f01c,A1; LEA 10f020,A2; 4 x MOVE.B (A0)+,(A1)+ / (A2)+; 49b42 LEA 10f01c,A4 (100012 = 2) / 49b52 LEA 49ab0(PC),A4; 49ab4..49ad4 mask test; reached from 8fa JSR bcb4 (USER init path, 10fd82 = 0) -> bd16 / bd20 BSR bbfa -> bc0a JSR bc1e

default-settings.why: the same declared default for P2 (10f020..10f023, used by 49b98 for the second player)
declared default settings bc0e / bc14: BYTE 10f026 := 3, BYTE 10f027 := 2 (written by bbfa after bc1e)
declared effect of be3a (end of bbfa, 10fd82 = 0): BYTE 10fd88 := BYTE 10f026 = 3. 4e8d6 copies it to the player record BYTE 99 (0 becomes 1)
default-settings.evidence: be3a TST.B 10fd82; be44 MOVE.B 7026(A5),7d88(A5); 4e8d6 MOVE.B 7d88(A5),99(A6); 4e8e0 MOVE.B #1,99(A6)

default-settings.why: declared effect of be3a: BYTE 10fd8b := BYTE 10f027 = 2 (490cc reads it in game mode, otherwise 3)

P0.description: control: game-mode declaration (ii), nothing pressed, IRQ execution

P1.description: main configuration: game mode + declared P1 player start at frame 1 + walkfire input

X1.description: P1 input (walkfire) + the declared default settings (default-settings): A and B are now read as presses, 3 lives, difficulty 2

X2.description: P1 start + default settings + jumpshoot input (jump, shot, aim up / down, crouch)

X3.description: P1 start + default settings + grenadeturn input (grenade, turn, crouch, jump)

X4.description: P1 start + default settings + mixed input (held buttons, D, diagonals, simultaneous buttons)
